listing_card.name: Rangeen Khidki Foundation
listing_card.description: The organization focuses on developing intersectional, rights-based interventions through capacity building and life skill education, while also working to build the capacities of organizations and institutions in key areas such as gender, sexuality, and sexual and reproductive health and rights.

profile.description: The organization focuses on developing intersectional, rights-based interventions through capacity building and life skill education, while also working to build the capacities of organizations and institutions in key areas such as gender, sexuality, and sexual and reproductive health and rights.
profile.mission: Rangeen Khidki Foundation works towards gender justice and empowerment with a rights based approach to enhance leadership, build networks in advocacy, towards entitlements, and dissemination of knowledge in community.
profile.vision: Rangeen Khidki Foundation envisions a world where all adolescents and young people across all gender and intersectionalities can access education, information, services and support related to their physical and mental wellbeing and can grow to their fullest potential as leaders.

rawData.vision_mission_raw: Rangeen Khidki Foundation aims to build innovative ways to educate and empower communities from a human rights perspective, working towards gender justice and empowerment with a rights-based approach to enhance leadership and build networks in advocacy.
